# Test fixtures

**Everything under `eprint/`, `arxiv/`, `dblp/`, `crossref/`, and `synthetic/` whose
file name starts with `synthetic-` was constructed by hand from documented formats.
None of it was captured from a live provider, and none of it is a bibliographic claim.**

Captured live responses (when an environment can reach the providers) will be stored
with a `captured-` prefix and a sidecar `*.provenance.json` (provider, endpoint,
access time, request parameters, parser version). No such files exist yet.
